Name: Maggs Birthday Dialogue Pack for BRRR Vanilla and SVE
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
[size=3]Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]![/size]

[size=3]This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43723]Birthday Redux Reworked Revamped (BRRR)[/url], you must have both mods for it to work.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768198861.png[/img]
[b][size=4]This pack currently includes:[/size][/b]
Birthday letter from Mom and Dad.
[size=3]Custom birthday greetings for all [/size]characters[size=3] from vanilla and SVE, all [/size]gifts and lines are fully unique to the character.
[size=3]Romance candidates:[/size]
[list]
[*]Lines based on farmer's relationship with them: low hearts, friend, dating, and married.[/*]
[*]Gifts begin at "friend" level. This is between 3 and 5 hearts depending on the character and their personality. For example, Sam will give gifts starting at 3 hearts, and Shane doesn't give gifts until 5 hearts.[/*]
[/list]Configuration included to turn off birthday greetings for any character.

[b]NOTE[/b]: This dialogue is based on a conversation topic, which will override most (I think all) other dialogue for that day. You can toggle off a character if you don't want to see birthday dialogue from them. Useful for story mods where you prefer to see a character's dated dialogue instead.

Things I don't know:
I can't tell if this conversation topic renews each year. I'm assuming it does so you should see the friendship progression for romance candidates.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199288.png[/img]
Custom lines included for:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53674]Magg's Technomancy Sebastian[/url]

If you are a mod author and want add customized lines to this pack, feel free to message me. You can also add the lines in your own mod and instruct players to turn off the character in this one (if vanilla or SVE).

In the screenshots:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38433]Maggs Dusky Interface[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30023]Maggs Emo Sebastian Sprites[/url]
